title: Harness baseline on the scaffold: coordinate contract, drive scenarios, FD0
desc: The scaffold already has window.__game (src/debug/hooks.ts) and verify --quick was green on 2026-11-10. Lock the baseline and the coordinate rule (owner inbox: correct coordinates from day 1 with tests). (1) Check the hook contract against docs/GAME_HOOKS.md and fix any gap; without ?debug=1 window.__game.debug must not exist (add a unit test or a scenario that opens the page without debug=1). (2) Add src/geo/projection.ts: lat/lon to world metres and back around one named Delhi origin constant (India Gate, 28.612894 N, 77.229446 E), east +X, north -Z, up +Y, accurate to under 0.5 m within 25 km of the origin (local transverse Mercator or ENU; write the choice to decisions.md as provisional until the architecture sign-off). No mirroring, no axis flips. (3) Unit tests: the origin maps to (0,0); Connaught Place central park (28.6315, 77.2167) lands at x -1246 +/- 25, z -2071 +/- 25 (north-west of the origin); Red Fort (28.6562, 77.2410) lands at x +1129 +/- 25, z -4821 +/- 25 (north-north-east); round trip error under 0.01 m; a point due north has x 0 and negative z. (4) Scenarios (input only, wait in sim time): drive_north (throttle 3 s from heading 0: z falls by over 10 m, abs x under 0.5 m), drive_turn_right (throttle plus steer right: heading grows and x becomes positive), coords_north_marker (camera at the origin looking north shows the red north post in the centre third of the shot; the builder reads the shot). (5) Play script harness/verify/milestones/FD0.js per milestones.json FD0 (real inputs only). (6) quick.json: core = boot_title, hooks_contract, perf_baseline, drive_north; areas mapped to src/car.ts, src/geo/, src/debug/. Notes: this is tooling and tests, no look change.
accept: npm run typecheck and npm test pass; the projection tests named above exist and pass (CP and Red Fort within 25 m of the given x and z, round trip under 0.01 m)

title: Plan the game: phases after P0
desc: From the signed style, architecture and game design (GAME.md), add the phases after P0 with task.mjs phase-add (goal, exit criteria, milestones) and add their missions to milestones.json.
